sources.title: Zhangjiajie Baofeng Lake: Tickets, Routes, and Travel Tips
sources.content:
Baofeng Lake is the only water-based scenic area in Zhangjiajie, situated approximately 20 kilometers southeast of Zhangjiajie National Forest Park. It provides a contrasting experience to mountain hiking.

Hours: April-November 7:00 AM-6:00 PM; December-March 7:00 AM-5:30 PM
Entrance fee: 110 CNY (includes boat ticket and shuttle bus)
Discounts for children under 18 and seniors over 60

Two Main Routes:
Classic Boat Tour (1-2 hours): Shuttle bus to dock for 20-25 minute cruise viewing emerald waters and karst peaks. Traditional boats where Tujia girls perform folk songs. After disembarking, see Baofeng Waterfall and iron cable bridge, plus optional China Giant Salamander Museum.

Hiking Exploration (4-5 hours): Following boat tour, tackle 4-kilometer Yingwo Village trail with moss-covered pathways, narrow gorges, and cliffside walkways. Baofeng Temple rewards hikers with mountain views.

Best Times: April-May and September-October (20-25°C). Summer 25-28°C but larger crowds. Winter quietest but coldest.

Safety: Hiking route requires companions due to slippery surfaces and limited cell signal. Sturdy footwear and water/snacks essential.

Location: 1.5 km south of Wulingyuan Town, taxi under CNY 10.

sources.title: Baofeng Lake, Baofeng Lake Zhangjiajie
sources.content:
Baofeng Lake is one of the alpine lakes with the highest altitude in China. As part of Wulingyuan Scenic Area, it earns the nickname "Holy Lake in the Sky." The 30-minute boat ride takes you around the beautiful lake to view unique rock formations, with a portion where two singers in traditional dress sing local tunes, giving you a glimpse of Tujia ethnic minority culture.

Several visitors note that seeing Baofeng Lake before the national forest park leads to stronger impressions. Tour guides on the boat only speak Chinese.

sources.title: Baofeng Lake: A Wonder of Lakes in Zhangjiajie
sources.content: Baofeng Lake is a wonder of lakes in Zhangjiajie. Located in the Wulingyuan Scenic Area, this alpine lake offers a peaceful contrast to the dramatic mountain scenery. The boat ride is the main activity, offering views of surrounding karst peaks reflected in the emerald waters.

sources.title: Baofeng Lake - Zhangjiajie - Travel China Guide
sources.content: Baofeng Lake travel guide. Tourists can first take a minibus (CNY 11, 40 minutes) at Zhangjiajie Long-distance Bus Station to Wulingyuan District and then hire a taxi (CNY 10) or take public bus. The lake is conveniently located just 1.5 km south of Wulingyuan Town.

sources.title: Baofeng Lake (2026) - Zhangjiajie - Tripadvisor
sources.content: Baofeng Lake visitor reviews. A beautiful and peaceful lake surrounded by karst mountains. The boat ride is relaxing with traditional singing performances. Good complement to the more strenuous mountain hiking in the national forest park. Allow 2-3 hours for the visit.

sources.title: 宝峰湖_百度百科
sources.content:
宝峰湖位于湖南省张家界市武陵源区，是世界湖泊经典。作为世界自然遗产、世界地质公园及国家5A级旅游景区的组成部分，该湖原为20世纪70年代的施家峪水库。

景区总面积4100亩，湖长2.5公里，平均水深72米。三亿八千万年前武陵源一带地壳下降，海水浸入，成为一片汪洋大海，经过亿万年地质作用形成独特石英砂岩峰林地貌。

核心景观包括石英砂岩峰林地貌、高峡平湖、宝峰飞瀑及深山古寺。湖中分布叠翠小岛，电视剧《西游记》曾在此取景。

门票：全价票96元+2元保险；优惠票50元+2元保险
开放时间：旺季7:00-18:00；淡季7:30-17:00
最佳游览季节：4-5月、8-9月
交通：距张家界市区34公里
游览时长：建议2-3小时

sources.title: Baofeng Lake Opening Hours, Entrance Fee and Boat Ride
sources.content: Baofeng Lake opening hours, entrance fee and boat ride details. The lake is open daily with seasonal hours. Entrance fee includes shuttle bus and boat ride. The scenic area also includes hiking trails and a waterfall. Best combined with Yellow Dragon Cave for a full day of non-mountain activities.
